summary: Implement Issue #5 scaffold/result isolation from the global-namespace kernel semantics (no namespace freezing): a private _restore_scaffold re-injects the official rlm_query bridge before every cell and in the outer finally so syntax/compile/query/runtime/repr/success exits all restore it; the fixed RESULT_NAME slot is deleted and a cell compiles into a statement body plus the final top-level expression as two code objects (both PyCF_ALLOW_TOP_LEVEL_AWAIT, positions preserved), capturing the expression value in an _on_eval local so no internal name is written, overwritten, popped or left in the user namespace; only CO_COROUTINE-flagged code objects are awaited (a bare awaitable last expression is returned as its repr, never auto-awaited); result formatting and truncation run inside the cell BaseException boundary before sys.stdout is restored and error frames use a raising-proof module-level _safe_str, so a raising __repr__/__str__ is a typed eval error and the same kernel/PID/globals keep serving. Existing error taxonomy, UTF-8 caps, persistent globals, top-level await, query bridge and Issue #1 lifecycle semantics are unchanged (src/runtime.ts untouched).
